description: This file defines the implementation of the ServiceContext class within the rialto::servermanager::service namespace. It manages the creation and access to a session server application manager and an IPC controller, initializing them in the constructor and providing a getter method.

classes.name: ServiceContext
classes.description: A class responsible for managing session server application and IPC controller instances within the service.

methods.name: ServiceContext
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the session server app manager and IPC controller with provided parameters.

methods.name: getSessionServerAppManager
methods.description: Returns a reference to the session server application manager.
